title: Design: a Categories search keeps the columns in place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named for example Quokka Parts.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Take a screenshot of the list.
  3. Type quokka in the search.
  4. Take a second screenshot of the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • The screenshot shows every column heading.

Step 3:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 4:

  • Compared with the first screenshot, the column headings Category, Pricing Matrix, Default and the tiers keep their places, as pictures 7.3 and 7.5 show.
  • The rows below them narrow to the matching categories.
